description.value: When it finishes a Long Rest, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} expels 1d6 seeds into unoccupied spaces on the ground within 30 feet of itself. After 24 hours, the seeds become creatures under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control. Roll 1d8 for each seed to determine the creature it becomes: on 1-4, @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.creatures.Actor.ijDugSHGb99eVGkB]{Twig Blight}; on 5-6, @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.creatures.Actor.f9NksFGaxI4bgb1p]{Needle Blight}; on 7-8, @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.creatures.Actor.KrONKumLj44wEnv8]{Vine Blight}.
